_comment: Golden fixture for community_strats loader (AC-1..AC-5). Input docs and expected output shapes. Producer-computed numeric values (oos metrics) are TEST INPUTS here — they are provided by the fixture, never hardcoded from module output.

docs.name: Simple Equal Weight
docs.edn_string_description: A minimal two-asset equal-weight tree. Used for AC-1 happy path.

docs.name: Another Equal Weight
docs.edn_string_description: Identical composition to strat-001. Used for AC-3 dedup test — same tree shape, different sid. Has higher OOS sharpe so should be RETAINED.

docs.name: No OOS Metrics
docs.edn_string_description: Valid tree with absent oos_metrics. Per AC-5: docs lacking the metric are KEPT (oos_metrics=None in candidate). Used to assert that missing-metrics docs survive the loader.

docs.name: Bad JSON
docs.edn_string_description: edn_string is deliberately not valid JSON. Used for AC-2 invalid-skip test.

docs.name: Invalid Tree Structure
docs.edn_string_description: edn_string parses as JSON but the tree fails validate_tree (unknown step). Used for AC-2 invalid-skip test.

docs.name: Missing edn_string field
docs.edn_string_description: No edn_string key at all. Must be skipped and counted invalid.

expected_output_shape.notes: Exact counts depend on implementation; tests assert shape and behavior (dedup, skip) not literal counts from this fixture.
